summary: Aligns the dashboard time-period filter with the content edge when the current organization has no selectable engine.
userImpact: The time-period filter no longer appears stranded to the left of an empty engine-filter slot on new or engine-free organizations.
When an engine is available, both dashboard filters remain grouped and right-aligned.

instructions: Upgrade the frontend image; no backend, configuration, or data changes are required.

notes: This frontend-only change does not alter persistence or database behavior.

documentation: The versioned technical release notes describe the dashboard empty-state alignment fix.
rollback: Redeploy the previous frontend image; no data rollback is needed.
validation: Focused Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit checks cover engine-free and populated dashboards at desktop, ultrawide, 200% equivalent reflow, and mobile widths.
Audited and visually inspected 1440x900, ultrawide, reflow, and mobile screenshots of the engine-free and populated layouts.
